unstated_but_needed: Mapping from each printed ALMA project code to targets, executions, spectral windows and displayed figures.
Calibration software versions, calibrators, flux uncertainties and any self-calibration applied to the reused ALMA data.
Channel widths, velocity reference frames and integration ranges for the molecular maps and spectra.
Visibility weighting, robust values, tapers, image grids, deconvolution masks and stopping thresholds.
Identity and calibration of the single-dish datasets, their relative flux scaling and the combination procedure.
Per-line synthesized beams, rms levels, primary-beam treatment and detection thresholds.
Astrometric registration and resolution matching between molecular maps, maser spots and HST structures.
Apertures, region boundaries and adopted stellar-radius conversion used for spatial extents.
Complete abundance-table source attribution and ESCAPADE inputs, molecular data, fitting procedure and uncertainties.

referee_caveats_inferred: This is a literature synthesis; its analysis sequence is a comparison workflow, not a documented new visibility-reduction pipeline.
Spatial association supports the proposed shock and nitrogen-enrichment scenario without uniquely establishing it.
The assertion of complete flux recovery is not accompanied by quantitative recovery tests here.
Different resolutions, excitation conditions, sensitivities and abundance methods limit direct cross-species and cross-star comparisons.
Some key maps and ratios depend on works listed as submitted.
The converted abundance and isotope tables omit source footnotes needed for reliable row-level attribution.
Printed project codes lack a target-to-product mapping and require archive verification.
